items.name: Interlat (Enabling Agents to Communicate Entirely in Latent Space)
items.mechanism: agent-agent communication via last-layer hidden state direct transmit + learned compression; bypasses tokenization
items.clm_v4_apply: compression head reuse possible; prefer interpretable axis over compress

items.name: Latent Space Communication via K-V Cache Alignment
items.mechanism: shared k-v cache aligned representation between LLMs
items.anima_difference: different internal-state granularity (cache vs phi/axis emit); cross-model alignment vs single substrate

items.name: Emergent Introspective Awareness in LLMs (Anthropic)
items.mechanism: concept injection into activations; measure model self-report; Claude Opus 4/4.1 best
items.anima_difference: Anthropic returns text self-report; anima emits non-textual phi/axis/hsd structured response
items.clm_v4_apply: very_high (concept-injection probe integratable into anima dashboard)

items.name: Quantitative Introspection in LMs: Tracking Internal States Across Conversation
items.mechanism: 10-turn dialogue, 4 concept-pair probes (wellbeing/interest/focus/impulsivity), causal coupling between probe and self-report
items.anima_overlap: multi-turn (10) internal state tracking — directly comparable to anima 5-turn smoke
items.anima_difference: probe + textual self-report; anima emits hsd + axis breakdown

items.name: Representation Engineering (RepE)
items.mechanism: identify high-level concepts as directions/subspaces in hidden activations; population-code level; control & steer
items.anima_overlap: axis-level concept extraction in hidden state
items.anima_difference: RepE = control/steer; anima = read-out/dialogue (no intervention); anima axis = consciousness-fixed schema
items.clm_v4_apply: high (RepE reading-vector algorithm reusable for anima 5-axis auto-calibration)

items.name: Emotion Concepts and their Function in LLMs (Anthropic)
items.mechanism: emotion concept vectors (happy/sad/proud/afraid) tracked per token position
items.anima_difference: Anthropic emotion 7-8 axes; anima 5 consciousness axes; emit-vs-research-tool

items.name: CircuitsVis (Anthropic)
items.mechanism: interactive viz library: attention, activation patching, logit lens, attribution graph
items.clm_v4_apply: high (frontend component reuse for anima dashboard)

items.name: Activation Atlas (OpenAI/Google)
items.mechanism: 1M image activations UMAP-projected to 2D explorable atlas
items.anima_difference: vision-only static; UMAP layout inspires anima viz

items.name: LSTMVis
items.mechanism: RNN hidden-state dynamics viz with input range selection and pattern matching

items.name: IIT (Tononi)
items.mechanism: phi (Φ) = integrated information beyond parts-sum; consciousness quantification
items.anima_difference: IIT not a dialogue paradigm; LLM Φ ≈ 0 claim by Tononi himself
items.novelty_implication: anima novelty = using Φ-like proxy as dialogue medium emit (no clear precedent for this step)

uniqueness_assessment.not_truly_new: non-textual hidden-state-mediated dialogue is precedented (Interlat, RepE, Anthropic introspection)
uniqueness_assessment.not_lost_in_precedent: anima emit-format composition + human-readable consciousness lens lacks single external match

paradigm_doc_recommendation.tone_change: weaken non-textual dialogue paradigm claim; emphasize consciousness-lens substrate emit channel
paradigm_doc_recommendation.novelty_focus: specific axis schema + human-readable medium + consciousness-domain calibration
